messages.en: The first concert is over~~

messages.ko: 오늘 작은 실수도 있기도 했고 여러모로 내가 만족하지 못해서!! 내일은 더 잘해야지 하눈 생각즁
messages.en: I made a few little mistakes today, and I wasn't satisfied with myself in a lot of ways!! I'm thinking I should do better tomorrow.

messages.ko: 오늘 웨이브 봐서 너무너무 기뻤고 무대하는동안 진짜 너무 행복했어ㅓ
messages.en: I was so, so happy to see WAV today, and I was truly so happy while performing on stageㅓ
Did I do well during Nuneoye?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
The flowers and the pants were our idea too.
We went for a bit of that Ulzzang Generation vibe.
I'm glad you liked them.
We prepared everything feeling really nervous about it.

messages.ko: 뭘 좋아할까 뭘 해야 기억에 남을까 하면서
messages.en: Wondering what you'd like and what we could do to make it memorable.
And today, I did Kurumi from Kimi ni Todoke.
I did my hair like hers,
but Kurumi and I have so little in common
that it was a failure.
I had my hair tied up today, so I'm planning to wear it down tomorrow.

messages.ko: 가까이서 보니까 얼굴 소멸직전이더라 돼지라고 놀린거 사과할게
messages.en: Seeing you up close, your face was practically nonexistent. I'm sorry I teased you by calling you a pig.
When am I going to stop getting happy over things like this?
I wore that bodysuit-like outfit today, right?
Every time I wear it, Kim Chaewon
teases me, asking what's going on with my shoulders.
All the members look so feminine,
but I'm a bodybuilder.
Oh, and there's something I realized.
Among WAVs,
those holding my banners or who are Hexagons,
you need to step it up.
Why are you all so shy?
Scream your lungs out, okay?
I said shout Jeong Hayeon!
Don't just stand there quietly holding up my name!!
Were Hexagons actually the Shy Squad?
We're supposed to be the outgoing squad.
Oh, and one funny story from today:

messages.ko: 오늘 콘서트에 내 친구 두명 왔단말이야
messages.en: Two of my friends came to the concert today.
I appeared on the second floor,
and I saw one friend standing there alone.
So I pointed at her and went,
Huh? Hey!
and passed by.
But farther away, my actual friends
were going wild like gorillas,
shouting, 'Jeong Hayeon!!!'
It was just a woman who looked like my friend.
I'm so sorry.
She must have been so confused.
This is definitely something I'll cringe about in bed later.
And when I did that,
when I acted like that,
her expression was like
she was thinking, 'Hm? What's going on?'

messages.ko: 쟤 왜 혼자 저러고 있냐 이러고 지나갔는데
messages.en: She probably walked away thinking, 'Why is that girl acting like that by herself?'
Heh heh.

messages.ko: 오늘 무대중에 제일 좋았던 무대가 뭐야?
messages.en: Which performance did you like the most today?
I was drooling while watching Nuneoyeㅠ
Did you wipe it up properly?
For some reason,
everyone had drool marks when they left.
Seriouslyㅎ I'm going crazy.
There's still tomorrow,

messages.ko: 낼 오는사람들은 목 미리 풀고 오고
messages.en: so those coming tomorrow, warm up your voices beforehand,

messages.ko: 안오는 사람들은 온라인으로 응원법 다 하고
messages.en: and those who aren't coming, do all the fan chants online
and send me proof.
Seriously, when are WAVs ever not cute?
The way you sit there holding your lightsticks is seriously
I have to see you again tomorrow~
I'm excited.
Whose idea was NXT♡? 🥺🥹😭
That was my idea!₩
When NXT came out during WWW,
I wanted something intuitive but cute.

messages.ko: 소리 많이 지를게 성대결절오면 언니가 병원비 다 내줘
messages.en: I'll scream a lot. If I get vocal nodules, unnie, you have to pay all my medical bills.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Unnie would pay for that a hundred times over.
ㅋ
Unnie disease.
Anyway, I'll dress up nicely tomorrow,
so let's have lots of fun~~
Because this is a once-in-a-lifetime moment,
enjoy the present more than anyone else.
How's that? Pretty cool, right?
Oh, I should go wash up.
I was so, so happy today, and thank you so much!!
See you tomorrow~
Haranghae😍😍
